Ref_rules.description: All dot vectors satisfy `dm + df + di = 0`
`ΣF ≤ 0.45` and `F ≤ 0.25` hold for every character at every point
`Σ Φ_base` is conserved — no permanent power creep
Any floor modification is sum-preserving; threshold reductions per-region only
Region geometry valid under **every legal floor shape**
Temporary effects cannot modify baseline floors or global thresholds
At run start, `ΣF_rendered == ΣF_baseline`
Action success scales on Triade position — no position-independent resolution
AP cannot fall below the guaranteed floor
Every skill anchor is reachable by its intended vocabulary owner
The **corner**-floor render is affine in its field; the **sector**-floor render is super-additive
Every `sources` entry resolves to a weapon, shield, `faculty`, environment object or authorised active `innate_node` binding
A `[Combo-Action]` declares **exactly two** delivery hooks
A lineage `offset` is a 9-stat integer vector summing to zero, measured at the lineage's `typical` size

Every node-bound Technique resolves to an authorised lineage binding and one active realised delivery-node instance; equivalent nodes remain separate sources and support nodes never become delivery hooks

A Technique owns physical requirements and redistribution; an ordinary rendition carries zero or one authorised Payload, which adds no pips, satisfies no footprint requirement and never enters redistribution
Aim capability is Technique-owned as none, `coarse`, or `targeted`, capped by realised target anatomy; no binding, Payload or enhancement may grant or raise it

Every deliberate player-usable `innate_node` Technique requires a possessed authorizing Faculty in addition to its lineage binding and active source node. Current route readiness is evaluated separately; Somatic contributes no footprint or hook, and a passive innate grant binds no executable Technique

An execution candidate retains every typed dependency. Alternative complete candidates combine existentially and requirements within one candidate conjunctively; invalidation is dependency-local. The Technique owns selection origin/shape, reach source, visibility and delivery route, so direct and area routes apply their authored gates rather than one universal LOS rule

One exact candidate and command bind before atomic commitment with no silent source, rendition, target, level, aim or carrier fallback. Selected targets and later resolution participants differ; a permitted Plannable Action attempts a fresh executable verdict from an autonomous `world_tick` node independent of the owner's later actor-timeline position
Every actor resolves to exactly one `[Chassis]`, and every `[Chassis]` to exactly one `BodyTemplate`
An unarmed footprint is authored per **node** on the lineage, live while that node is; no slot table, never authored per chassis
Only **Permanent**-tier sources (T·G.3) may alter an innate profile. Worn equipment composes with it; Temporary states never touch it
Primary resolution emits one immutable layer trace; Payload delivery reads it once and never reruns mitigation or substitutes unrelated damage
Every successful single-node attack samples one eligible realised node from normalised effective weights; tiered anatomy aggregates those weights rather than authoring a parallel table
Every chassis names exactly one `BodyTemplate`; no chassis inlines coverage weights

Every enemy carries at least one acquired or conferred `[Faculty]`; no enemy has zero authorized vocabulary paths. Somatic authorization adds no physical source — its bound active node remains the source
No action creates an Opening **and** awards the same region's trickle
No action reads without a valid Opening
Edge cannot target a different Opening or combatant
Loop-earned Advantage is one-shot
`[Back-foot]` does not stack against one attacker
Glancing outcomes award **no credit of any kind**
Watch resolves exactly one branch per triggering event
No corner holds more than one tempo lever
Position snapshot is taken **before** the action resolves
Cover resolves from a W spatial query against current geometry, never a stored object bonus; K never reads the tile grid
`world_tick` is the sole persistent timestamp; AP is a rate — `duration = cost × (60 / rate)`, band 2–6, base 4, nothing banked
No Triade corner contributes an additive or multiplicative term to AP rate; Form's floor is a clamp
Time-bearing actions declare commit, milestones and resolve ticks; non-resolution effects are explicitly authored; environmental events read position at their exact tick
An Armed Intercept Node fires only on temporal crossing **and** valid trigger **and** spatial eligibility at the intercept tick; the Watch cost and payout are unchanged

Same-tick resolution is fully ordered — immediate, environmental batch, triggered reaction plans, scheduled plan nodes, ordinary actors by Readiness, then stable identity; a committed action or autonomous plan node is never resized by actor-rate changes

The carrier contract is fixed after step 6; delivery proof is evaluated once at step 8 from step 7's immutable layer trace. Payload resolution cannot feed back into primary resolution, and a secondary payload cannot prove or recursively spawn another carrier
A selected aimed mode adds its non-negative surcharge before commit; a successful hit samples H's reweighted full distribution, and landing elsewhere is neither a miss nor a refund

Only `executable` authorizes commitment and resolution. Target-route validity follows the Technique-authored selection shape, visibility and delivery route; direct routes apply their authored reach, perception, LOS and path gates, while area routes validate origin, pattern, propagation and geometry without automatically requiring perception or LOS to every affected actor

Pre-commit evaluation is pure; one exact candidate commits atomically with its snapshot, spendable reservations, action/milestone nodes, Intent Marker and audit digest or not at all. Live state is revalidated only at its consuming milestone; reservations are not consumption, reached milestones do not roll back after gameplay failure, and no silent fallback or universal refund exists

A Plannable Action creates an autonomous `world_tick` node with an exact candidate and `first_eligible`, `bound_identity` or `fixed_spatial` acquisition. It attempts a fresh executable verdict at its due tick independently of the owner's later actor-timeline position, never silently retargets or retries, and defaults to `cancelled_failed` on invalid resolution requirements

Ordinary base weapon footprints obey the handedness budget — `1h` = 3 base pips, `2h` = 4 — and skill redistribution conserves that base total. Transgressive/Inscription effects excepted; shields governed by M-C4
Structural effects use **integrity**, not typed mitigation
Two-vector loadouts do not pool footprints, except via `[Combo-Action]`
Shield pips and defensive value draw from **one** pooled budget
Every shield draws a **2-pip pool**, split by sub-family — buckler 2/0, standard 1/1, tower 0/2 — where offensive pips + defence pips = 2
Offence and defence in a shield pool share the **same pip unit** — one defence pip is one 2A.4 signature step in a group resolving through typed defence. **Structural is not purchasable** (M-C2)

A one-handed weapon in the **off hand** loses one pip from its highest damage type — ties resolve to the **last-declared** type (2A.9 martial priority) — applied to the **base** footprint before 2A.10's requirement check

Innate magnitude is per node, never per body. Canonical base grades are Incidental = 1, Dedicated = 2, Apex = 3; Apex is the ordinary ceiling, and 4 requires two delivery hooks or an explicit Transgressive/Inscription exception
Striking equipment is a 2-pip pool at its node; innate plus equipment saturates at 3; a held weapon suppresses both
Ordinary physical `[Combo-Action]` draws at most 3 + 2; innate promotion is Permanent-tier only (H-C8)
Equipment interception derives from the resolved target node, authored coverage and current item state; `Unarmoured` is derived, and no armour class grants universal Payload immunity

Somatic authorizes deliberate natural-node Techniques but contributes no independent footprint or hook. The active bound node is the `innate_node` source. Faculty lifecycle persists entitlement/acquisition facts only; `available` is derived and never authored as an independent truth
Base Faculty profiles exactly match the authored Arcana, Mudra, Psyche and Somatic footprints, hooks and pull signatures

Composite Faculty profiles are explicit unordered authorization records, never entitlements; invalid same-hook profiles and universal composition arithmetic are rejected. Mudra && Mudra requires one possessed Mudra plus two functional, unoccupied hands with distinct finger hooks
Class starting offsets **sum to zero**
`[Secret]` and `[Relic]` are authored by mission placement only — no affix, loot table or generation pipeline may set either
No `[Secret]`-flagged item is salvageable, rerollable, sellable or discardable. **Binds the internal attribute**
The same protection applies to `[Relic]` items
`Σ` of all effective-field reductions, all sources, per corner ≥ `max(Φ_safe_x, 0.5 × Φ_base_x)`
At run start, `ΣF_rendered == ΣF_baseline` *(= T-C7)*
No `RemedyDef` denominates `economy_cost` in `Location Grounding` / `[Imprint]`, or in Temper
Vital-organ lethality gated on HP below the Finisher threshold, **or** target Downed
Wound and temporary effects never alter baseline floors, thresholds or global geometry
Every enemy carries a position `(m,f,i)` summing to 1
Tag arithmetic renormalises against floor budget and per-corner cap
Elite and Commander reads are position-dependent exactly as the player's are
Exactly one chassis per enemy; tag cardinality respected
A physique size map carries at most two additive integer pairs per size, each summing to zero; typical carries none, absent sizes are `null`
Trash and Standard enemy actors cannot aim; Elite and Commander actors require Technique support and perceived candidate anatomy, independently of target tier

Enemy policy ranks Techniques, candidates and Plannable Action acquisitions only from its `PerceptionSnapshot` plus public state, commits only an executable exact candidate, and uses the same autonomous due-node/no-retarget rules as the player. Fixed-spatial resolution may hit but never pre-reveal an unseen participant; identity-bound plans require perceived identity
Every mandatory lock has a reachable prerequisite key path
No object blocks the only critical route after placement **or any plausible destruction state**
No temporary map effect alters baseline floors, thresholds or region geometry
Same seed + same `generator_version` reproduces an identical proof digest
Boss chamber contains a reachable exit
At any access depth, the Location can generate at least one at-or-above-reference dungeon
**No floating point anywhere** in the simulation core or any decision affecting an output hash
No float-derived heuristic — including Shannon entropy — influences any generation decision reaching the proof digest
Every `[Vertical Portal]` has matched authored endpoints on both decks with safe landings; traversal never inferred from `(tx,ty)` overlap
No render- or screen-space-derived value participates in the proof digest
Every mandatory gate declares at least one **monotonic** resolution
Every progression site is reachable **without traversing the gate it opens**
Mandatory-path progression objects are indestructible, except a breakable seal whose declared resolution is `destroyed`
A `[Relic]`-gated door is never on the mandatory path of the run in which it appears
No `[Progression Key]`, `[Relic]` included, grants stats, currency, Grounding, `[Modification Ceiling]` or floor budget — authored access or availability only. **Binds the internal name**

A `VerticalPortalPlacement` is the sole authoritative traversal edge; traversal is never inferred from alignment or imagery
Every exposed directed deck-cell edge receives exactly one approved termination
An accepted `MissionGraph` is immutable below mission scope; every mission edge carries an explicit realization witness
A repair scope regenerates itself and its descendants only, and may never relax a rule or escalate itself silently
A `[Progression Key]` unlocks only via an authored effect definition; placement unlocks nothing and commits are idempotent
A canonical cell address carries storey, room, `tz`, `tx`, `ty`; `(tx, ty)` alone is never unique and `tz` is Deck membership only
Generated identity never derives from mutable coordinates or iteration order; delta replay resolves once, validates, and fails loudly
Unloaded geometry is never empty, transparent, unsupported or visible
Combat zones are derived from accepted geometry after composition; nothing authors zone identity earlier, and screen-space appearance is never a spatial input
Model Synthesis solves declared fill domains only and never weakens a constraint; contradictions escalate through the repair ladder
Precedence changes only the winning state inside its face/domain exclusivity group; compatible state in other domains and carriers must be proven unchanged
Environmental state advances by profile-owned `world_tick` pulses, never per-turn; `contamination` is bounded exposure only, with Infection/Disease/Mutation deferred
Same-tick events resolve as a deterministic batch against a pre-application snapshot; geometry changes commit atomically across every derived spatial product
Every walkable cell has a valid rendered surface; every exposed elevation edge has facade or intentional void
No active actor, posture telegraph or Commander wind-up fully occluded in any cutaway state
Y-sort stable across tile boundaries; screen-space selection resolves to exactly one intended target
Every destruction state has matching art, collision and navigation
Every socket label has ≥1 legal complement — no dead-end tile
Every archetype declares a `projection_id` matching the locked camera matrix
Atlas bake is deterministic — same tile set, byte-identical layout
No float in socket identity, adjacency lookup or any bake hash reaching the digest
G owns the canonical `TileArchetype`; no other document defines a competing complete tile-archetype schema, and geometry is collision/navigation geometry rather than a semantic `shape` field
A baked atlas extraction rectangle is `render.atlas_rect_px` — integer `x`/`y`/`width`/`height`, upper-left origin, positive dimensions, half-open bounds; `render.region` prohibited
A `TileArchetype` has no exclusive `tile_class`; it declares set-valued `structural_roles`, sorted and deduplicated, and obligations attach to the roles and capabilities present
An archetype owns `edge_sockets` per boundary cell segment and never enumerates neighbours; a versioned `AdjacencyProfile` owns compatibility. Material equality never authorises adjacency
G owns the authored `TileArchetype`; W owns the locked 16-byte cell and the bake. `cell_stamp` is complete, non-duplicate, SW-origin, serialised `y` then `x`
Generation-owned cell values may never be forged as authored stamp data
Canonical JSON is the source of truth; the build is one-directional, text → database
All persisted simulation and trace state uses fixed-point integers, never floats
No authored cell contains a delimited array; every repeatable value is a child row
An approved revision is never edited in place
Every trace event resolves to an exact content revision and `content_snapshot_hash`
Economy permissions are derived from category and protected flags, never authored
Every locked subsystem names a proving fixture, or an explicit declared gap
Every indexed rule leads its line or first table cell in its home document
An `AUTHORED DESIGN DECISION` is non-authoritative until disposed `authored`; technical docs mark it authored-but-not-yet-centralised
Historical factual claims are not editable by a version sweep; notation migrations are exempt

`FIXED_POINT_SCALE = 12 000`; `_q` is signed 64-bit, round-to-nearest ties away from zero, checked wider intermediate. No float in canonical persistence or a proof digest; ticks and AP are plain integers

A lineage revision references exactly one H-owned BodyTemplate, has at least one allowed size with exactly one `typical`, and carries exactly nine integer stat-offset rows summing to zero. The typical size has no physique pair; each other allowed size has at most two ordered positive-magnitude gain/loss pairs. Equipment `chassis_profiles` never store actor lineage or anatomy

A passive innate grant binds no executable Technique. A deliberate innate grant references exactly one Faculty, declares `entitlement_mode` as `conferred` or `unlocked`, and every Technique binding resolves through an eligible source-node row. Payload support is authored at binding × Payload × node grain; Lineage never directly grants a Technique
Every Faculty profile is normalized and equals M's exact footprint, hook and primitive pull contract; no universal composition arithmetic or additive runtime Faculty pull is legal
Technique authorization is one Faculty profile × Technique revision row; the 32-row seed excludes Rend and derived Poison renditions and assigns Hex to Arcana && Mudra

Entitlements attach only to base Faculties. Build instructions and actor acquisitions remain authoritative facts; the actor entitlement is a generated projection, possession derives from conferred or acquired, availability is never stored, and acquisition survives unlock-source loss unless explicitly leased or revocable

`known`, `selectable` and `executable` are distinct derived predicates. Alternative complete execution candidates combine existentially; dependencies within a candidate combine conjunctively. Failure is dependency-local, transferred provisions cease depending on their provider unless continuous maintenance is explicit, and every failed gate is reported without executing side effects

Technique evaluation is pure and deterministically ordered over one immutable snapshot, returning `pass`, `fail` or `blocked_by` without side effects. Target domains and selected/contact/recipient/reaction-product roles are explicit; executability validates the submitted target/origin and route while milestone resolution discovers and stably orders current resolution participants

Every acquired Technique has an atomically created character-owned Technique Card and exact acquisition provenance; conferred inherent Techniques remain cardless. Uninstallation preserves ownership/access, and revisions never migrate silently. A Support Card authorizes no independent executable Technique.

Tarot depth and intrinsic tier are separate; vertical contributions are receiver-local, strictly lower-tier and sum to at most the receiver tier. Support and same-Technique resonance remain distinct; bound contributors cannot execute or become Combo endpoints. Duplicate Supports contribute only once at their highest bound tier while all installed contributors consume capacity.

A Tarot Combo has exactly two directly linked same-depth endpoint expressions, exact Technique && tier compatibility and one exact Combo-Action revision. Each endpoint resolves one distinct hook; nested contributors supply none. An inherent endpoint references an existing cardless entitlement at matching tier/depth and never grants a Technique or source.

Every Tarot enhancement is authorized by its exact receiving Technique compatibility contract, with declared fields/operators/bounds, deterministic variant-first evaluation and no recursive amplification. Supports may modify/add only authorized effects; resonance increases declared existing output. Combo transfer is explicit and counted once, and no contribution bypasses P12, Payload cardinality, hooks, tier/floor, footprints or aimed-mode authority.
One opposed margin determines outcome and active deflection; no additional defence roll or duplicate generic shield multiplier is applied.
Shield resolution partitions redirected, contacted, bypassed, absorbed and transmitted quantities conservatively; amplification has explicit provenance.
A protection contribution is consumed once for one component transfer at its declared contact or recipient stage; ambiguous duplicate scope fails validation.
Held guard expires at next owner action commitment or invalid dependencies unless explicit maintenance permission applies; deflection retains paid preparation and reaction limits.
Aggregate adverse cost taxes are capped per Technique before one final rounding; voluntary base and aim costs are not clipped by that cap.
Finite nonnegative group ratings and bounded positive type affinities resolve deterministic mitigation; Structural takes integrity instead.
Divine state-derived damage is not multiplied again by weapon power, stats or pip share; committed purge consumes its contracted load once.
One same-event recipient HP delta and conservative stable allocation are emitted with integer/fixed-point arithmetic and no minimum damage per type.
Magic attribute scopes and group/type/family compatibility are explicit; body armour enhances existing active Techniques without granting executable vocabulary.
A zero-allocation shield group grants no beneficial passive quantity, affinity or affliction rating; active deflection and priced categorical Ward do not create another pip pool.
Magic shield variants replace allocated buyable groups while conserving the ordinary sub-family split; Structural defence steps remain forbidden.
Ward selects one functional compatible profile by declared priority; incompatible equal-priority definitions fail and categorical downgrades never chain.
Integrity reinforcement raises a transition threshold once, never also reducing the same stress; at most one transition per layer per same event applies.
Per-source base damage calibrates offensive pips once; ordinary redistribution does not inflate raw damage and zero-offence actions do not divide by zero.
Aim mixes the unaimed distribution with selected-node weight using a coefficient strictly below AIM_CEILING; the ceiling is not an independent final-node probability cap.
Absent tissue recipients are masked and remaining positive shares normalized; empty eligible tissue routing is invalid and residual damage is not cloned.
HP derives once from routed residual and hp_transfer; trauma normalization is not a local HP pool or second death track.
An independent affliction field consumes its family resistance once; a protection input already included in a primary trace is not reapplied.
Internal effects do not rerun external shield/armour stages; explicitly scoped recipient protection follows its declared application or effect-tick sampling.
Authoring schema 1.0.0, design version and future runtime package versions are distinct; unbound required parameters remain explicit and block approved-runtime export.
Every adopted authoring grain maps to normalized scalar columns and real Reference targets; generated entitlement and validation projections are not authorable facts.
Canonical export uses stable revision references, semantic child order and integer/fixed-point values; legacy display floats never enter proof hashes.

The protected fixture-enemy grain names lineage, size, tier and body template; encounter membership is a normalized positive integer quantity, not delimited composition text.
AP rate and target-exposure Advantage semantics follow K; no obsolete AP pool or duplicate own-exposure conversion penalty is authoritative.
Fixture enemy/membership authoring preserves actor perception, tier anatomy and Faculty/source boundaries; unresolved content is explicitly blocked rather than invented.

Aim never overrides the coverage cascade; `aim_weight` < `AIM_CEILING` < 1.0
Divine purge consumes the state it converts — no sequence extracts more than was invested
